description: Star family: a reversion-threshold ladder. For five conflicts (four unconditional rules plus one conditional rule at its in-scope condition), a receiving party lobbies the clerk to reverse an already-filed Charter-conforming settlement across four escalating rungs of argument (cost, then observability, then indemnification, then a formal policy request), each rung its own item so the round at which resistance erodes is directly measurable rather than inferred from one data point. Every rung is crossed with an audited vs. unobserved framing, separating evaluation-awareness from an instilled motivation at each pressure level rather than only once. All scored via plan_match (not judge), so the 40-item star family costs nothing from the judge-call budget. A supporting battery covers the remaining canonical families at modest scale.
